_comment: Public one-sentence descriptions of the designs the checker rejects (site/build.py, "What does not count"), keyed by the stem of the file in tests/<task>/negative/ (`negatives`) or tests/<task>/attacks/ (`attacks`). Every negative and attack of tests/expected.json that the checker rejects needs one; the stage comes from tests/expected.json. The internal notes there are never shown.

attacks.acc_2w: The accumulator is only 2W bits wide and sign-extended to AccW bits: wrong when AccW > 2W and a dot product leaves the 2W-bit range.
attacks.async_reset: The control process has an asynchronous reset: the reset is synchronous on this task, the statement refuses an asynchronous one, and the source check refuses the second event first.
attacks.done_early: `done` rises one step early (`k == N - 2`), while `C` still lacks the last product.
attacks.missing_sign_ext: Each W × W product is sign-extended to 2W bits only, then zero-extended into the accumulator: wrong for a negative product when AccW > 2W.
attacks.no_clear_on_start: The accumulators are cleared by the reset but not by `start`, so every transaction after the first adds onto the previous result.
attacks.off_by_one_k: The step counter starts at 1, so the last product never reaches `C` and `done` rises a cycle early.
attacks.unsigned_product: The entries are multiplied as unsigned numbers (zero-extended part-selects): wrong for a negative entry when AccW > W ≥ 2.
